title: ₹168, With a Link (UC02: how an AI answers with web search)
label: UC02

t.story: Ravi and the shop are made up · our test is real
t.oldTitle: Toor dal wholesale price in Hyderabad today
t.stepsHead: HOW IT ANSWERED, STEP BY STEP
t.stepsSub: our test · a made-up mini web of 6 pages
t.noToday: today's date? the app never told it
t.testSub: the shop AI = a small free AI on our computer
t.bSub: by the app: 10 of 10 · typed in the question: 10 of 10
t.builder2: put today's date in its instructions
t.askAgain: asked again in 10 new chats: ₹168 every time
t.whereNotWhen: a link shows WHERE it read, not WHEN
studyRows: a different slip: the source itself
t.rule3: NO DATE? TYPE TODAY'S DATE, ASK AGAIN

lines.text: One sixty-eight a kilo, with a link! [1] The market today: one forty-two! Thirteen hundred rupees gone!
lines.show: ₹168 a kilo, with a link! The market today: ₹142! ₹1,300 gone!

lines.text: The link is real. [1] That page does say one sixty-eight.
lines.show: The link is real. That page does say ₹168.

lines.text: I searched: [1] the top page said "today". [2] I read it: no date anywhere. [3] I answered with the link. <pause 0.8> [4] But this app never told me today's date.
lines.show: I searched: the top page said "today". I read it: no date anywhere. I answered with the link. But this app never told me today's date.

lines.text: So what do I do? [1] A, trust the link. [2] B, ask again. [3] C, open the link.
